//: Browser tools for Claude Code in this repo, both free and local. Chrome DevTools MCP opens a real Chrome: a performance trace with Core Web Vitals, the console, the network, the accessibility tree. Playwright MCP opens WebKit (Safari's engine, --browser webkit; firefox for Firefox), for the bugs only Safari shows; it needs the engine once: npx playwright install webkit. Neither runs at build or test time and nothing a page loads changes. Pinned versions; Dependabot does not watch this file, so bump them by hand now and then.
